{{Quote|Subject wanted for the beating death of an off-duty Coruscant Police Officer.|Panza Hondi's bounty posting by the Coruscant Police Force|<ref name="SWBH" />}}
A '''police officer''' served in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. While off-duty, the [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Panza Hondi]], a [[Guineo]] criminal. In response to the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] death, the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|Police Force]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Hondi that was claimed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].

==Biography==
An individual worked for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]] as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]]<ref name="SWBH" /> as of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> While working as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]], the individual served on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At one point, the officer was taking a break from [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] duties only to be attacked<ref name="SWBH" /> and [[Death/Legends|murdered]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Hondi, Panza}}</ref> by a [[Guineo]] criminal named [[Panza Hondi]], who beat the officer to death. In response to the killing, the Coruscant Police Force put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Hondi worth 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for live capture and 1,000 credits for [[Gender/Legends|his]] death.<ref name="SWBH" /> Hondi was eventually apprehended by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Police officer was first mentioned in Panza Hondi's entry in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', a guide for ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' published by [[Prima Games]] and released in [[November]] [[2002]].<ref name="SWBHSGp68">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> In [[December]] of the same year, the police officer was mentioned in the bounty for Panza Hondi in ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWBH" /> Neither the bounty entry featured in the strategy guide<ref name="SWBHSGp68" /> and the game<ref name="SWBH" /> nor Hondi's entry in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established the police officer's biological characteristics or [[Time/Legends|time]] and place of death.<ref name="TCSWE" />
